name: Dynamic Workspaces
description: Hyprland-style workspace indicator for GNOME Shell: displays only the active workspace and those containing open windows. Features direct navigation (Super+1..0), follow-focus window moving (Super+Shift+1..0), scroll cycling, and multi-monitor filtering.
description[pt_BR]: Indicador de workspaces no estilo Hyprland para GNOME Shell: exibe dinamicamente apenas a workspace ativa e as que contêm janelas abertas. Inclui navegação direta (Super+1..0), mover janela acompanhando foco (Super+Shift+1..0), rolagem com mouse e suporte a multi-monitor.
